modal.infoBody1: Thumb counts as five. Left hand = tens (0–90). Right hand = ones (0–9).
modal.infoBody2: Addition uses three helpers: Direct, the Little Friend (5-complement), and the Big Friend (10-complement) with a carry. Each step shows a rule, finger movement, and current value.
modal.infoBody3: Subtraction uses Direct, the Little Friend (5-complement), or a Borrow with the Big Friend (10-complement). A blue flash indicates borrow, a green flash indicates carry.
tour.step1Text: Interact with the 3D hands here. Drag to rotate, pinch/scroll to zoom, and watch the fingers move.
tour.step2Text: Switch modes here: Tutorial (learn counting), Arithmetic (practice addition/subtraction), and Challenge (matching games).

tour.step5Text: Use Back and Next to step through the hand animations at your own pace.
tour.step6Text: Toggle Auto to play steps automatically, adjust the speed, or Reset the hands back to zero.
tour.step7Text: Click the Gear icon to switch languages, select skin tones, toggle dark theme, or toggle sound.

rule.fiveCompAdd: Little Friend of {{bR}} is {{c5}} → add 5, take {{c5}}
rule.tenCompAdd: Big Friend of {{bR}} is {{c10}} → carry 1, take {{c10}}
rule.fiveCompSub: Little Friend: close thumb (−5), open {{c5}} below
rule.tenCompSub: Borrow 10, then add {{c10}} on the right
rule.tensOnly: No change in ones — focus on tens
narration.removeComplement: We will remove {{complement}} on the right
why.directAdd: Each lower finger is 1, thumb is 5. Room to add {{bR}} without going past 4 lower fingers, so just open them.
why.directSub: Enough lower fingers open to subtract {{bR}} directly.
why.fiveCompAdd: Can't add {{bR}} directly because lower fingers are filling up. Trick: add 5 (open thumb) and remove Little Friend {{c5}} because 5 = {{bR}} + {{c5}}.
why.tenCompAdd: Ones don't fit in one hand. Carry 1 to left (worth 10) and take Big Friend {{c10}} from the right because 10 = {{bR}} + {{c10}}.
why.fiveCompSub: Not enough lower fingers to subtract {{bR}}. Trick: close thumb (−5) and open Little Friend {{c5}} because 5 − {{bR}} = {{c5}}.
why.tenCompSub: Right hand too small for {{bR}}. Borrow 1 from left (worth 10), then add Big Friend {{c10}} because 10 − {{bR}} = {{c10}}.
explain.subTensAfterBorrow: Left lost 1 ten in the borrow, so it stays at {{leftAfterBorrow}} now
explain.subTensAfterBorrowHint: No change — tens already reduced by borrow
carry.announce: Carry 1 ten to the left hand
borrow.announce: Borrow 1 ten from the left hand
tutorial.placeValue: Place value: left = tens (×10), right = ones (×1). Thumb = 5, each finger = 1.

install.modalBodyAndroid:
To install Hand Math on your Android tablet:

1. Tap the three dots menu icon (⋮) at the top-right corner of the Chrome browser.
2. Tap 'Add to Home screen' or 'Install app'.
3. Tap 'Add' or 'Install' to confirm.
install.modalBodyGeneric:
To install Hand Math:

- Android: Tap the menu (⋮) -> 'Add to Home screen'.
- iPad/iOS: Tap the share button (⎋) -> 'Add to Home Screen'.
